auth.noFirebase: Sign-in isn't available because Firebase didn't load. Your progress is saved in this browser.
auth.merged: Signed in. Your progress from this browser and from your account have been merged.
auth.loadFail: Couldn't read your progress from the cloud ({code}). Using the one in this browser.
auth.saveFail: Couldn't save your progress to the cloud ({code}). It's still saved in this browser.
auth.unauthorizedDomain: This site ({host}) isn't authorized for Google sign-in yet. The course admin needs to add it in Firebase → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains. Meanwhile you can browse the course without an account and your progress is saved in this browser.
auth.popupClosed: You closed the Google window before finishing. You can try again.
auth.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the Google window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
auth.other: Couldn't sign in ({code}). Your progress is still saved in this browser.
